question: Which Prime Minister wrote the preface for the autobiography I Am Giorgia by Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Prime Minister Narendra Modi penned the preface to Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni’s autobiography *I Am Giorgia*.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **PM Modi described Meloni as an “extraordinary political leader who combines ideas and heart,” emphasizing the deep ties between India and Italy.**
 
• **He linked his preface to Meloni’s ability to combine tradition and modernity and highlighted their shared civilizing values.**
 
• **PM Modi’s preface to *I Am Giorgia* was described as a political and personal gesture, marking it as one of the few prefaces he has written.**
 
• **The book was referred to by PM Modi as Meloni’s own “Mann Ki Baat,” linking it to his popular radio program that connects him with the public.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Relationship Between Leaders__

 __
 
• The relationship between PM Modi and PM Meloni gained attention after their selfie at COP28 in Dubai, with the hashtag #Melodi going viral.
 
 
 
• PM Modi’s Prefaces__
 __
 
• PM Modi has written only two other prefaces—one for Anandiben Patel’s book in 2014 and one for Hema Malini’s autobiography in 2017.
 
 
 
• Book Release Details__
 
 
• The Indian edition of I Am Giorgia will be released under the title I Am Giorgia – My Roots, My Principles.
